entities.name: PMID:27510715
observations: Wang et al., American Journal of Clinical Pathology, 2016, evaluated an algorithmic SLE testing and pathology-consultation referral pathway in a safety-net health system.
The study appears to be an observational pre/post health-services or quality-improvement evaluation; the abstract does not report randomization or a concurrent control group.

entities.name: Systemic lupus erythematosus
observations: Patients with suspected SLE were referred for rheumatology consultation in Harris Health System.

entities.name: SLE referral pathway
observations: The intervention used a one-click SLE testing order with automated reflex laboratory testing, clinical-pathologist interpretation, and pathology-based triage before rheumatology evaluation.
Before implementation, approximately 80% of patients lacked a complete laboratory workup at their first rheumatology visit and rheumatology waiting time was approximately 6 months.
After implementation, rheumatologist waiting time decreased by 50%; the abstract did not report referral-completion percentage, sample size, or an absolute post-intervention wait.
